subject: Owners rollforward & readiness: OKR playbook, canary, and contingency
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Brightside Labs <qbr@brightside.ai>
Cc: Acme Ops <acme.ops@example.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Owners rollforward & readiness: OKR playbook, canary, and contingency

Team —

Thanks for the early reviews on the Q2 playbook. We need a clean owners rollforward by EOD Friday so the product ops team can lock the QBR packet on Monday. Key asks below: 

- Owners: confirm who owns each KR in the attached OKR_Playbook_v3.pdf (column "Owner") and call out any handoffs.
- Canary: provide a one-paragraph canary plan for any KR that is publicly facing (doc or customer-visible metric).
- Contingency: flag any KR at risk (>= 40% risk) and propose a rollback or mitigation.

Marissa — can you lead consolidation and ship an owners matrix by Wednesday morning?
Grace — need your risk read on infra-backed KRs (latency/cost).
Karthik — please update the risk worksheet (link below) with heatmap and SLO boundaries.
Ben — partner-facing KRs: please coordinate with Brightside on their dependencies.

I copied Brightside and Acme ops because they have items that intersect our canary timeline; we'll keep external calls to the final alignment meeting next Thursday.

Attachments: OKR_Playbook_v3.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Sooj
Soojinn Lee (she/her)
Head of Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Sooj — noted. I'll own consolidation. Quick clarifications: 

1) For multi-owner KRs (e.g., "Improve inference unit economics"), do we expect a single primary owner or allow co-owners listed? I recommend primary + 1 fallback.
2) Canary plan: shall we use the existing canary template (canary_runbook.md) and attach it, or free-form text?

I'll take the workbook and produce an owners matrix (tab-delimited) by Wed 09:00 PT and run a short owners roll call on Wed 11:00 PT to confirm.

Subject: Re: Owners rollforward & readiness: OKR playbook, canary, and contingency

Thanks — quick risk callouts from infra: 

- KR#3 (KV cache improvements): medium risk. We have a staffing gap on the optimizations track; estimate completion slips 3 weeks without additional contractor support.
- KR#7 (Dedicated capacity SLA): high risk until we finalize the autoscale policy; current perf regression on long tails was seen in internal load test 05/01 (logs attached in tracker).

Proposed mitigations: prioritize KR#7 canary on internal tenants only and delay public rollout until we validate with Brightside. For KR#3, I can propose a contractor ramp if Marissa confirms budget.

- KR#7 moved to "High Risk" band; recommended mitigation: internal canary + rollback flag at 2% error increase.
- KR#3 bumped to "Medium-High" until contractor onboarding is confirmed.

I'll also add a short runbook excerpt for the canary and attach canary_runbook.md to the owners sheet.

Subject: Re: Owners rollforward & readiness: OKR playbook, canary, and contingency

Thanks everyone — good progress. Actions confirmed: 

- Marissa: owners matrix delivered Wed 05/05 09:00 PT (received) — I'll merge into the QBR packet.
- Karthik & Grace: risk heatmap and canary excerpt accepted; KR#7 to internal alpha first.
- Ben: coordinate alpha timeline with Brightside; target start 2027-06-01 for 2-week alpha.
- Budget: Marissa to confirm contractor budget for KR#3 by EOD Thursday; if not confirmed we'll deprioritize the optimizations tranche.

External: Brightside & Acme — we'll follow up with alpha scope and invite lists by next Tuesday. No customer-facing rollout until we validate internal canary.

I'll finalize the owners rollforward and mark the QBR packet as "alignment-complete" once Marissa confirms budget or a deprioritization decision is logged in INF-4821.

Thanks —
Sooj
Soojinn Lee
Head of Strategy & Ops, Redwood Inference
